definition: Went from one place to another, typically over a distance.
exampleSentence: Last summer we travelled across southern Italy.

definition: Went to see someone or a place.
exampleSentence: They visited three historical museums in Prague.

definition: Intercepted and held something moving, or boarded transport.
exampleSentence: We caught the express train just before departure.
The plane arrived twenty minutes ahead of schedule.
